note: Each world is pinned by the SHA-256 of its module. Clients refuse a module whose hash differs. On the chain, this file becomes ledger state.

worlds.name: Junction
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: The crossroads. Every portal leads to another world.

cap.name: Ball Cap
cap.desc: A classic. Red, because of course.

antenna.name: Antenna
antenna.desc: Picks up signals from other worlds. Probably.

partyhat.name: Party Hat
partyhat.desc: Every day is a launch day.

halo.name: Halo
halo.desc: Glows. That is the whole point.

echo-1.name: Echo I
echo-1.desc: One of the Founder's Echoes, a piece of their voice (Skyreach). Bound to whoever found it.

echo-2.name: Echo II
echo-2.desc: One of the Founder's Echoes, a piece of their voice (Glowcave). Bound to whoever found it.

echo-3.name: Echo III
echo-3.desc: One of the Founder's Echoes, a piece of their voice (Neon Circuit). Bound to whoever found it.

echo-4.name: Echo IV
echo-4.desc: One of the Founder's Echoes, a piece of their voice (Crystal Rush). Bound to whoever found it.

echo-5.name: Echo V
echo-5.desc: One of the Founder's Echoes, a piece of their voice (Spire Clash). Bound to whoever found it.

crown.name: Founder's Crown
crown.desc: Proof you opened the Vault in Junction. Wear it and you can sense the Founder's Echoes.

katana.name: Katana
katana.desc: A folded-steel blade. Press 1 to strike: it deals damage wherever a world has something to hit, like the training dummies in the training yard. In Spire Clash it adds attack damage.

knight.name: Knight
knight.desc: Plate armour, a plumed helm and a red cape, with a real walk, run and sword swing. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

barbarian.name: Barbarian
barbarian.desc: Furs, a horned helm and a heavy cape. Swings like they mean it. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

mage.name: Mage
mage.desc: Robes, a cape and a wide-brimmed hat with a point to it. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.desc: Hooded, light on their feet, and hard to spot in a crowd. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

robot.name: Robot
robot.desc: A cheerful, chunky robot. Its strike is a punch, and it gives a thumbs-up when you win. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

skeleton-warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.desc: Rattling bones in a dented helm, eyes aglow. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

skeleton-mage.name: Skeleton Mage
skeleton-mage.desc: A grinning skull under a pointed hat, with robes that have seen centuries. A character: your items still show and work, and a worn hat replaces its own headwear.

springboots.name: Spring Boots
springboots.desc: Jump a second time in mid-air. A machine: works in any world that allows double jumps and machines.

bubble-shield.name: Bubble Shield
bubble-shield.desc: A brass field-engine. Press 2: a bubble that no hit gets through, for 6 seconds. Recharges in 25.

pocket-seeker.name: Pocket Seeker
pocket-seeker.desc: A brass seeker with a restless needle. Press 2: a trail of light runs to the nearest coin, gem or item still to find in the world you are in.

worlds.name: Neon Circuit
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: Race a neon figure-eight above a midnight city. Beat par for the Sigil of Speed.

hoverboard.name: Hoverboard
hoverboard.desc: A Neon Circuit racing board. Press B to ride it in any world that allows boards.

sigil-speed.name: Sigil of Speed
sigil-speed.desc: One of three sigils that open the Vault in Junction. Won by beating par on Neon Circuit.

worlds.name: Spire Clash
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: A lane battle: towers, minion waves and a rival champion. Your gear comes with you.

worlds.name: Glowcave
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: A glowing cavern under everything. Bring a light, follow the crystals, glide the Deep.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.desc: A Glowcave lantern. Lights the dark around you in any world that allows light.

sigil-deep.name: Sigil of the Deep
sigil-deep.desc: One of three sigils that open the Vault in Junction.

worlds.name: The Last Summer of Bronze
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: A story, chapter 1: The Door in the Sea. You walk out of a shining sea arch onto an island that wonders if you are a god.

lsb-guest-knife.name: Bronze Guest-Knife
lsb-guest-knife.desc: Eumaia's father's knife, yours while you are a guest of Thyra. Press 1 to strike: it cuts, rings and breaks what it reaches.

lsb-bread.name: Hearth Bread
lsb-bread.desc: Barley bread and salt from the rocks. Keep a crust: you never know who is hungry.

lsb-token-own.name: Guest-Token
lsb-token-own.desc: Half of a clay disc. Eumaia keeps the other half: if your grandchildren ever meet hers, they owe each other a supper.

lsb-token-linnet.name: Linnet's Token
lsb-token-linnet.desc: The other half of a guest-token Eumaia kept for nine years. Find Linnet, if she is anywhere, and give it to her.

lsb-kyllo-note.name: Kyllo's Note
lsb-kyllo-note.desc: A folded note for Eumaia. Run it to her hearth before the sundial's shadow touches the line.

lsb-feather.name: Pedlar's Feather
lsb-feather.desc: From the hat of a pedlar whose footprints wet sand never keeps. Feet are the first gift.

lsb-house-seal.name: House Seal
lsb-house-seal.desc: The seal of the House of the Double Axe. Show it to anything bronze that tries to stop you.

lsb-stag-mask.name: Stag Mask
lsb-stag-mask.desc: Carved for a hunt nobody remembers. Press 2 and you are a stag for 20 seconds: faster, and a leap like nothing on two legs. Press again to change back.

lsb-tablet-fish.name: Guest Tablet (a fish)
lsb-tablet-fish.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

lsb-tablet-wheel.name: Guest Tablet (a wheel)
lsb-tablet-wheel.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

lsb-tablet-star.name: Guest Tablet (a star)
lsb-tablet-star.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

lsb-tablet-wave.name: Guest Tablet (a wave)
lsb-tablet-wave.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

lsb-tablet-mountain.name: Guest Tablet (a mountain)
lsb-tablet-mountain.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

lsb-tablet-bird.name: Guest Tablet (a bird over a boot)
lsb-tablet-bird.desc: One of Eumaia's guest tablets, flung out by the tremor. Bring it back to her.

worlds.name: The Origin
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: The Founder's first world, never finished.

founders-mantle.name: Founder's Mantle
founders-mantle.desc: Read the Founder's last letter, in the Origin.

worlds.name: Crystal Rush
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: Ninety seconds. Grab every crystal you can.

rush-visor.name: Rush Visor
rush-visor.desc: Scored 12 or more in Crystal Rush.

prism-cape.name: Prism Cape
prism-cape.desc: Scored 35 or more in Crystal Rush. Worn by very few.

worlds.name: Skyreach
worlds.author: elsewhere
worlds.blurb: Climb the floating isles. The summit holds a sigil and a glider.

glider.name: Glider
glider.desc: Hold jump while falling to glide. A machine: works in any world that allows gliding and machines.

sigil-sky.name: Sigil of the Sky
sigil-sky.desc: One of three sigils that open the Vault in Junction.

hourglass.name: Hourglass
hourglass.desc: Old glass, older sand. Hold 2 and you run back through your last minute, as you were; let go to carry on from there. Recharges in 20 seconds.
